assumptions: The refutation is of the CONJUNCTION as stated. The lattice correction it also carried — P(kinds) under ⊆, UNKNOWN as ⊤ rather than an incomparable token — survives and is re-stated in IMPACT-UNKNOWN-TOP.
Scoped to INV-R7.3 rather than timeless: a closure with a genuine ⊤ default is not impossible, it is what R7.4 built. What was false was the claim that INV-R7.3 had one.
attrs.evidence: REFUTED AT R7.4 BY GPT-5.6, AND THE CLAIM WAS THIS ARTIFACT'S OWN. The statement asserts a closure `with an undeclared-edge default of ⊤`. The shipped implementation was `for (const k of imp) { if (!narrows || !(k in narrows)) { out.add(k); continue; } ... }` — that is T?(S) = S, IDENTITY, with the comment `undeclared ⇒ identity ⇒ conservative` written beside it as its own justification. The registry sentence and the executable disagreed and the ledger recorded the sentence. Reproduced before the fix: `{correctness}` → `{correctness}`, `{authority}` → `{authority}`, `⊤` → `⊤`. IDENTITY IS A FALSE-NEGATIVE MACHINE — an unknown edge F→G with an upstream `{correctness}` defect that can also invalidate an authority decision reports only `{correctness}`, and the authority impact never enters the worklist, so `ignorance costs precision, never safety` was false as shipped. R7.3'S POSITIVE CONTROL SEEDED ⊤ AND ONLY ⊤, AND identity(⊤) = ⊤: the control agreed with the defect at the single point where the two functions coincide. The `strictly more precise than the untyped closure` conjunct was also true only BECAUSE of the defect — under the correct semantics, with no discharged narrowing, the typed closure EQUALS the untyped one.

attrs.review_focus: The instructive part is not the missing branch, it is the CONTROL. R7.3 chose the one seed at which the wrong function and the right function return the same answer, and wrote the justification for the wrong one in a comment. `Seeding only ⊤ is forbidden as the sole test` is now a meta-check on the suite, in scripts/emb-impact-closure.mjs §5.
attrs.statement: A typed impact closure over P(kinds) with an undeclared-edge default of ⊤ is executable, is strictly more precise than the untyped closure, and collapses to the seed alone when every edge is narrowed to ∅.
